observation.command: cd /tmp && curl -sSL --max-time 30 -o SHASUMS256.txt https://nodejs.org/dist/v24.22.0/SHASUMS256.txt && grep "node-v24.22.0-linux-x64.tar.xz" SHASUMS256.txt | awk '{print $1}' > expected.txt && sha256sum node.tar.xz | awk '{print $1}' > actual.txt && cat expected.txt actual.txt && diff <(cat expected.txt) <(cat actual.txt) && echo CHECKSUM_OK
